Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### New

- **Flowing line.** With the **World** layout, **Lyrics → Position** has a new **Flowing line** switch: the floating words read left to right in rows, like a sentence, instead of scattering around you.

### Faster

- **Glow no longer slows the game down.** With the **World** layout and shaders on, turning **Glow** on used to cost about a third of the frame rate; now it costs almost nothing (in our test: 235 fps before, 366 fps now). If you use ImmediatelyFast, it already did this job and SkyLyrics leaves it to it.
